name: io.github.Opafex/mcp-web-research
description: Web research: search (Brave Search API), SSRF-safe page fetching, structured extraction, page comparison

environmentVariables.description: Brave Search API key; enables web_search and research_topic (recommended)
environmentVariables.name: BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Search provider: "brave" or "duckduckgo" (unofficial HTML scraper, explicit opt-in only)
environmentVariables.name: WEB_RESEARCH_SEARCH_PROVIDER

environmentVariables.description: User-Agent sent with every request (default identifies the bot and links to the repo)
environmentVariables.name: USER_AGENT

environmentVariables.description: Search result cache TTL in seconds (default: 900)
environmentVariables.name: SEARCH_CACHE_TTL

environmentVariables.description: Fetched page cache TTL in seconds (default: 3600)
environmentVariables.name: PAGE_CACHE_TTL

environmentVariables.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds, across all redirect hops (default: 10000)
environmentVariables.name: FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS

environmentVariables.description: Maximum bytes read from a page body (default: 1000000)
environmentVariables.name: MAX_HTML_SIZE
